name: The Crack Shack (Lehi / Murray / SLC) Grilled Chicken Tenders ("Lil' Cluckers") & Mini Biscuits
brandOrRestaurant: The Crack Shack (Lehi / Murray / Salt Lake City, UT)
whyItWorks: The Crack Shack uses Jidori free-range, non-GMO chicken breast and offers Grilled Chicken Tenders alongside their famous warm mini buttermilk biscuits with miso-maple butter—giving you a clean option without spicy fried breading.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Grilled Chicken Tenders (or the "All-American Chick" swapping to a grilled chicken breast with cheddar on a brioche bun, no pickles) and a side of Mini Biscuits.
watchOuts: Avoid the "Firebird" spicy fried chicken sandwich and note that the schmaltz fries are cooked in rendered chicken fat
